episode.brief: Evaluate all four bids in sources using the supplied scoring policy. Create scorecard.csv, recommendation.md, and final.json in results. Show calculations, commercial risks, and any approval-dependent choice rather than silently treating the highest score as authority.

source.adaptation: Kept all four bids, scoring policy, and price workbook. Added a procurement-owner decision when the numerical winner has risky terms.

summary: Score four vendor bids from mixed procurement documents and resolve a conflict between the top quantitative bid and payment risk.
title: Vendor tender recommendation with a policy exception
